findings.title: `verifySafeHtml` can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when the common prefix and suffix overlap
findings.description: The suffix loop compares `value` and `sanitized` from the end without bounding it by the prefix length `start`. When the strings share overlapping characters, `value.length() - end` or `sanitized.length() - end` can fall below `start`. For example, value `aa` and sanitized `a` give `start=1` and `end=1`. Then `sanitized.substring(1, 0)` throws. The mismatch path, which should only report a message, can crash the verifier instead. Bounding the suffix loop by `Math.min(value.length(), sanitized.length()) - start` would fix it.

findings.title: Italian text in the Lithuanian login messages file
findings.description: The changed `loginTotpStep1` line reads "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian, not Lithuanian. The same wrong-language value appears in the account `messages_lt.properties` `totpStep1` line. The translation should be Lithuanian, or the key should keep its previous value.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese characters in the Simplified Chinese account messages file
findings.description: The changed `totpStep1` value uses Traditional characters ("手機", "應用程式") and a full-width colon, but this file is Simplified Chinese. The Simplified form would be "在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：".

findings.title: Misspelled method name `santizeAnchors`
findings.description: The method is named `santizeAnchors` but should be `sanitizeAnchors`. The call site uses the same misspelling, so it compiles and runs. The name is still wrong and should be fixed before it spreads.
